grammar_patterns.pattern: We always [verb]. / I sometimes [verb]. / She never [verb].
examples: We always go to the sports center.
I sometimes go to the library.
She never goes to the shopping mall.
Billy always rides his bike to school.
They sometimes watch TV.
Mom never listens to music.
My birthday is in May.
Emma's birthday is in March.
We sometimes go to the beach in August.
He plays soccer on Fridays.
Dad never works on Saturdays.
You never watch TV on Mondays.
We get up at eight o'clock.
I always have lunch at one o'clock.
The children always go to bed at nine o'clock.
Can we go to the shopping mall?
Can we go to the playground?
Can we go to the museum?

grammar_patterns.pattern: Do you ever go to the [place]?
examples: Do you like watching movies? Yes, I do.
Do you ever go to the movie theater? Yes, I sometimes go to the movie theater.
Do you ever go to the sports center?

phonics.description: The ow sound as in cow and the ou sound as in house.
